canonical_statement: The study sought to longitudinally examine the availability and non-prescribed use of buprenorphine-naloxone among people who use drugs in Vancouver, Canada.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: We thus sought to longitudinally examine the availability and non-prescribed use of BUP-NX in a prospective cohort of PWUD over time in Vancouver, Canada.

canonical_statement: The study included 1,617 participants; 60% were male, 56.5% were of white ethnicity, and median baseline age was 47 years (IQR 37–54).
